faq_a1: Fix_Radar is a tech platform that connects homes with maintenance problems to local experts in real time.
faq_q2: How do I report an issue?

1. Tap the report button.
2. Take a photo of the problem.
3. Add a description and category.
4. Nearby technicians will receive your alert.
faq_q3: How do I know if a technician accepted my report?
faq_a3: You will receive a notification and can see the status on the map as "Technician on the way". Chat will be enabled to coordinate details.
faq_a4: Yes. Fix_Radar is free to report issues. Technicians may have their own rates for the services performed.

about_tagline: Technical solutions for your home in minutes
what_is_fixradar_body:
Fix_Radar is a collaborative platform that connects people with technical problems at home with local experts willing to help.

Our mission is to make home maintenance easier, reduce wait times in emergencies, and create a reliable technical support network in every neighborhood.
our_mission_body: Ensure no home is left without technical assistance, connecting the need with the skill immediately.
step_1: Spot an issue in your home.
step_2: Report the problem with a photo.
step_4: An expert comes to fix the problem.
made_for_community_quote: "Fix_Radar transforms the way we care for our home. What is a problem for you is a service opportunity for someone skilled."
turn_fix_mission: "Turn every fix into a local mission."
terms_s1_body:
Fix_Radar is a collaborative platform that allows users to report technical issues or home maintenance needs so that other users with technical skills can offer assistance or be hired.

Fix_Radar acts solely as a connection and information platform and is not directly responsible for repairs, contracts, or transactions carried out between users.
terms_s2_body:
Fix_Radar does not employ the technicians who appear on the platform.

All profiles, skills, ratings, and quotes are managed directly by the users.

Fix_Radar does not guarantee the final outcome of a repair, nor the quality or safety of services provided by third parties.
terms_s3_body:
Although Fix_Radar encourages a safe community, it is the user's responsibility to verify the identity and credentials of the technician or client before allowing access to their home.

Fix_Radar is not responsible for incidents arising from unknown persons accessing private properties.
terms_s4_body:
The user is solely responsible for:

• Accurately describing the issue.
• Agreeing on payment terms and service execution.
• Complying with local safety regulations.

Any action taken by the user outside the app will be under their sole responsibility.
terms_s5_body:
Technicians should only access homes or private properties by invitation and explicit permission from the client.

Fix_Radar does not authorize or promote unsolicited access to homes or restricted spaces.
terms_s6_body:
Users acknowledge that repair work (electrical, plumbing, etc.) involves inherent risks.

Fix_Radar will not be responsible for:

• Workplace accidents.
• Collateral damage to property.
• Non-performance of services.
• Economic losses from failed repairs.

The user assumes all risks associated with hiring or providing services through the app.
terms_s7_body:
Each user is responsible for all content they post within the app, including photos of issues, technical descriptions, and service ratings.

Fix_Radar may moderate content deemed inappropriate or false.
terms_s8_body:
It is prohibited to use Fix_Radar to:

• Post illegal services.
• Offer dangerous repairs without certification when required.
• Harass clients or technicians.
• Impersonate professional identities.
• Distribute spam or advertising unrelated to repairs.

Fix_Radar may suspend accounts that violate the community's trust.
terms_s9_body:
The app uses location services to show nearby issues and optimize technicians' response time.

By using Fix_Radar, the user agrees to share their approximate location for operational purposes.
terms_s10_body:
Fix_Radar is provided "as is".

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Fix_Radar and its developers will not be liable for personal, material, or economic damages arising from the technical services managed through the platform.
terms_s11_body: All rights related to the Fix_Radar name, logos, and software belong to its developers and are protected by intellectual property laws.
terms_s12_body: Fix_Radar may suspend accounts with recurring low ratings or reports of misconduct to protect the integrity of the technician network.
terms_s13_body: Fix_Radar may add or remove technical service categories at any time.
terms_s14_body: Continued use of Fix_Radar implies acceptance of the updated Terms and Conditions.
terms_s15_body: These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of the user's local jurisdiction.
security_clause_body: Fix_Radar is a connection tool. All repairs and home access are the sole responsibility of the users involved. We strongly recommend requesting references and certifications for complex jobs.
privacy_intro:
Welcome to Fix_Radar. Your privacy is fundamental to the trust of our technical services network. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our app to report issues or provide services.

By using Fix_Radar, you accept the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
privacy_s1_body:
Information provided by the user
• Full name
• Email address
• Profile photo and photos of completed work
• Technical specialties (for technicians)
• Issue descriptions and photos of the problem
• Chat messages between client and technician

Location information
To connect issues with nearby technicians, we collect:
• Current device location (foreground and background if the technician radar is enabled)
• Approximate address of the issue report

Location is critical for the alert system to notify the right technicians based on proximity.
privacy_s2_body:
We use the information to:
• Connect clients with local technicians.
• Notify technicians about new issues in their area.
• Enable direct communication to coordinate repairs.
• Show users' reputation and ratings.
• Improve the safety of the technician network.
privacy_s3_body:
To facilitate the service, we share:
• Photos and details of the issue.
• Username and rating.
• Location of the issue (visible to registered technicians).

We do not share your phone number or exact address until you decide to do so through the private chat to coordinate the visit.
privacy_s4_body:
Fix_Radar uses tools to:
• Analyze which types of issues are most common.
• Optimize the technician search radius.
• Detect technical errors in the app.
privacy_s5_body:
We implement encryption and Firebase security measures to protect your messages and personal data.
However, the user is responsible for sensitive information voluntarily shared through chat.
privacy_s6_body:
We keep the work history for reputation and warranty purposes.
You can request the deletion of your account at any time from settings.
privacy_s7_body: Fix_Radar is aimed exclusively at adults with legal capacity to hire or provide technical services.
privacy_s8_body: You have the right to access, rectify, or delete your personal data by sending a request to our technical support.
privacy_s9_body:
If you have questions about your privacy:
Email: support@fixradar.tech
privacy_summary_1: ✅ Location: Used only to match issues with technicians.
privacy_summary_2: ✅ Data: We do not sell your information to advertisers.
privacy_summary_3: ✅ Chat: Messages are protected for your safety.
privacy_summary_4: ✅ Transparency: You control when you share your exact address.
privacy_footer: Fix_Radar: Connecting technical skills with home needs, safely and privately. 🛠️🏡🛡️
